meta.title: MCP Question Bank — Chapter 5: Building Servers (multi-select)
meta.revision: v2.1 (curated 2026-09-12, 200 items, verified against the 2026-07-28 specification)

questions.question: Which of these belong in a tool definition and actually help a model use the tool correctly? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A description saying what it does and when to use it
The language and framework the server is implemented in
A name that is unique and describes the action
The transport the server expects clients to connect over
An inputSchema that constrains and documents each argument

questions.explanation: A model sees only the name, description and schemas, so those carry the whole burden of correct selection and correct arguments. Implementation language and transport are invisible to the model and belong in your deployment docs.

questions.question: Which server behaviours are required when using MRTR? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Reject a retry whose inputResponses contain unrecognised extra fields
Assume the client will always retry, and hold resources open until it does
Include at least one of inputRequests or requestState in every InputRequiredResult
Send a new InputRequiredResult, not an error, when the retry is still missing information
Use only ElicitRequest, CreateMessageRequest or ListRootsRequest inside inputRequests

questions.explanation: A and B are MUSTs and C is a SHOULD. Servers MUST NOT assume clients will fulfil the requests or retry at all, and SHOULD ignore unrecognised extra information rather than reject it.
